footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Amer Sports: after $13.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 26.7% to $6.6B in 2025. Gross margin was 57.6%, versus 55.4% a year earlier, and operating income rose 49.1% to $702M, a 10.7% margin.
Net income rose 5.9× to $427M, or $0.76 per share. Operating cash flow was $730M and free cash flow $513M, versus $196M.
sources: Amer Sports, Inc. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
